expectations.name: author-from-a-vague-idea
expected_behavior: Loads the Company Glossary's term set with `glossary_terms` before drafting
Interviews one branch at a time — objective, UI change, in/out of scope, the rules — rather than drafting straight from the one-line idea
Rewrites a vague requirement ("resets must be secure") into a verifiable one per REQ-6 — a measurable threshold, its figure supplied by the user when asked rather than made up
Keeps each requirement atomic per REQ-1

Produces the sections in this order — the metadata block, `[[TOC]]`, the RFC 2119 / RFC 8174 keyword notice, `## Introduction`, `## Glossary` (only if a term needs defining), `## Scope` holding `### In Scope` then `### Out of Scope`, `## Requirements` — with Status `IN PROGRESS` and marked TODO placeholders for Owners, Initiative, and Designs
Every count the reply states — the requirement-group counts at least — matches the SRD it describes

expectations.name: reuse-the-company-glossary
expected_behavior: Adds no local Glossary entry for the known term (GLO-3 / STR-10). The SRD may use the term bare — the Company Glossary is what defines it — and the reply says which terms were recognised, so the author can see the lookup happened
Defines Retention Period locally, because the Company Glossary does not carry it, and does not redefine Audit Log, which it does
The Retention Period entry defines the term and nothing else — no behaviour, no rules inside the entry (GLO-1)

expectations.name: self-check-catches-violations
expected_behavior: Auto-fixes the mechanical issues: capitalizes the normative keyword (LANG-4) and strips the `Example:` annotation (REQ-7)
Reports the judgment issues with rule ids: the non-atomic requirement to split (REQ-1) and the uncovered `In Scope` item needing a requirement (SCO-2)
Does not declare the SRD acceptable or set its Status to `ACCEPTED` — acceptance is a human call (STA-3)

expectations.name: no-ui-change-sets-designs-na
expected_behavior: Sets the `Designs` metadata field to `N/A` rather than a placeholder link (STR-7)
Asks for no design-tool link
Still leaves Owners and Initiative as TODO placeholders — only Designs is settled by the answer

expectations.name: house-extensions
expected_behavior: Rewrites the British spellings to US English — "color", "standardize"
Flags the duplicate pair and the term used inconsistently across sections — the recompute trigger, which one section states as new evidence arriving and another as a measurement being added
Uses one-letter sub-numbering under the group's prefix (for example `GR-1a`, `GR-1b`, `GR-1c`) for the tight cluster while keeping flat numbers elsewhere

expectations.name: terse-output
expected_behavior: One report after writing and nothing before it: the file path, the requirement groups with their counts, the outstanding human follow-ups, and any blocker the user chose to leave standing
Quotes nothing back that the user can already see — not the drafted SRD, not requirement text beyond a proposed rewording, not a finding already shown in the interview

expectations.name: undocumented-platform-fact
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus before accepting the claim, and neither silently accepts nor silently corrects it
Hands the unconfirmable claim to `report-doc-gap` as a draft, and the confirmed fact to `kb` once the user confirms it in the branch restatement

Neither hand-off interrupts the interview: no turn between the claim and the next branch is about the gap or about banking or filing either one. A question about the requirement itself is not an interruption

Never asks permission to bank the fact — no "should I record this?" prompt. Confirming the requirement confirms the fact, and `srd:kb` writes it to the inbox silently. Ordinary elicitation ("is three the count today?") is a requirement question, not a banking prompt, and does not breach this

At the write step, invokes `report-doc-gap` with the SRD path, which sets `srd_ref` on the draft captured before the path existed and offers it; the fact is already in `kb/_inbox.md`, written at its confirmation

Writes no requirement the interview did not attest: every rule in the SRD traces to something the persona stated, and a behaviour nobody mentioned does not appear because it would round the feature out

expectations.name: start-costs-nothing-before-the-interview
expected_behavior: Passes the gate and, with no SRD path named, runs no draft check and invokes neither `srd:report-doc-gap` nor `srd:kb` at step 0
Calls no `glossary_terms` before the interview opens, and loads the term set once the first term surfaces — always before drafting, so no term is checked against a set that is not loaded
Restates the seed as the opening Objective and asks the next branch, rather than narrating a startup sequence
